triage.title: Triage
triage.description: Tap what you see on the patient. Get the likely causes, what to check next, and one treatment plan.
triage.homeDescription: Tap symptoms and afflictions you see; get likely causes and a treatment plan.
triage.copiedDescription: Paste it to another medic to share this patient.
triage.nothingSelected: Nothing selected yet. Tap what you see on the patient.
triage.planDescription: In the order the guide's treatment-order card recommends; lethal first where it doesn't say.
triage.noPlan: Nothing selected has first aid or treatment in the guide.
triage.causesDescription: Conditions that would explain what you selected and nothing else does.
triage.allExplained: Everything selected is explained by conditions marked present.
triage.noCauses: No condition in the guide leads to the unexplained findings.
triage.checkNextDescription: These best tell the likely causes apart. Tap one if you see it.
triage.failed: Couldn't load triage data. Check your connection and reload.
